title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with eight ordered APPID XDATA groups

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

documents.title: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
documents.relevant_rule: Group 1001 names the registered application that begins an XDATA group; group 1000 carries a string value.

implementation.change: The selected simple-LTYPE XDATA path admits up to eight distinct ordered APPID groups. Typed validation, source binding, unchanged-state verification and staged output projection all check eight references in order and retain existing work/byte budgets.
implementation.preserved_contract: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Nine-or-more APPIDs, metadata-bearing providers, earlier versions and application-specific XDATA meaning remain outside this profile.

proof.source: Eight distinct APPID names and eight following string payloads are exact and ordered in physical XDATA, typed readback and source-bound bare APPID records.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations preserve exact physical XDATA order and payloads. Fresh import confirms all eight typed pairs and exactly one emitted record for each APPID provider. Internal binding checks prove all eight provider source handles and LTYPE identity.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the eighth APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination for all four output combinations; restoring the provider succeeds on the same adapter. A late eighth-provider name mutation refuses atomically for ASCII and binary output; restoring the original name succeeds on the same adapter with exact output and readback.

limits: This qualifies only eight distinct bare APPID providers, each followed by one group-1000 string, in one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA profile. Nine-or-more APPIDs, repeated provider names, metadata-bearing providers, other payload orders/compositions, LTYPE schemas, versions and application meaning remain unqualified.
The evidence proves transport and source/output identity only. It does not establish MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or general format support.
next: Replace the arbitrary per-LTYPE APPID count cap and fixed reference-slot arrays with dynamically sized storage bounded by existing input work and retained-byte budgets. Preserve ordered source identity, canonical name uniqueness, exact emitted output/readback and atomic missing/late-mutation refusal/retry; exercise a materially higher provider count and the existing budget refusal path. Keep provider metadata, other payload compositions and application meaning separate.
